compatibility_notes.Hermes: For-of destructuring loop closures capture final binding; canvas width reads/writes height (400 instead of 600). Rows all equal; canvas steps 16–23 differ. Reproducer in docs. No x86-64 JIT in pinned revision.
compatibility_notes.Kiesel: Initial pre-normalization trace smoke failed entering canvas with TypeError: Cannot convert undefined to Object. Final normalized trace and three timing rounds completed all 24 steps; not production qualification.
compatibility_notes.zig-js: Investigated but not built: requires Zig 0.17-dev and sibling zig-gc/zig-regex dependencies. This project uses Zig 0.16.
